semantic_import_policy: External ontologies are design and validation references unless an explicit versioned mapping, licence review, competency test, and semantic-import decision are committed. No external class is imported merely because a repository is owned by the maintainer.

sources.rationale: UOGTO provides the maintainer's most mature formal ontology-engineering pattern, but its game-theory semantics are not animal or mobility semantics.
HPO is useful as a mature ontology-governance reference; clinical phenotype classes are outside PelicanBench and are not imported.
The repository is the intended persistent-identifier registration route. The namespace is not represented as published until registration evidence exists.
